purpose: To apply for the inspection of records under rule 58 using Form NCLAT-3.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Two days before the date on which inspection is sought, unless otherwise permitted by the Registrar.
steps: Prepare Form NCLAT-3 for the application for grant of inspection.
Present the form at the filing counter of the Registry between 10.30 AM and 3.00 PM on any working day.
Submit the application at least two days before the date on which inspection is sought, unless permitted otherwise by the Registrar.
Wait for the Registry to submit the application with its remarks before the Registrar.
Obtain appropriate orders passed by the Registrar upon consideration.
checklist: Ensure Form NCLAT-3 is used for the application.
Check that the filing is done between 10.30 AM and 3.00 PM on any working day.
Confirm the application is presented at least two days before the desired inspection date, unless the Registrar permits otherwise.
Verify that the inspection date is not on the date fixed for hearing or on the preceding day if the case is pending, unless ordinarily permitted.
watch: Inspection of records of a pending case shall not ordinarily be permitted on the date fixed for hearing or on the preceding day.
